g.text: Residue of chain B, numbered as in the structure file
5 Å between the centres of two boxes
An interface has no centre. The residues of chain B that touch chain A come in 6 stretches of its
chain: each box stands where its residue's centre lies on the plane through those centres, at one
scale, seen from the side of chain A; a line joins neighbours in the chain, a dotted line two with up to
three residues between them. Those of chain A are not drawn where they lie but beside the boxes
they touch. A line to one of them is a pair of residues, at the shortest of its contacts of one kind.
Measured on the boxes as drawn: 26 pairs of boxes are neighbours (centres within 8 Å) in the figure
or in space; none is a neighbour in the one and more than 10 Å apart in the other: 100 % of
neighbour relations are kept. Distances between the centres of boxes differ from those in space by 8
% (root mean square). The residues' centres lie 2.8 Å (root mean square) off the plane; 2 boxes
were moved off their places to keep boxes apart.
All 16 residues of chain B at the interface are shown, with 37 contacts.
